svg.aria-label: Render of the assembled 64 by 16 LED display: four WS2812B 32x8 panels behind a smoked grey plexiglass front showing 1234, with a section through the layer stack
svg.title: led-display, reference build
svg.desc: Face-on view of the assembled display and a section through its layers, to the cut sizes in 3D/8x32: a 670 by 190 mm sheet with twelve M5 perimeter fixings, carrying a 64 by 16 pixel matrix on a 10 mm pitch. The section shows the five layers at their real thicknesses - 3 mm front panel, 6 mm short spacers, 2 mm aluminium support panel, 22 mm long spacers, 3 mm back panel - with a countersunk screw entering from the front and a dome nut closed on the back.
svg.text: 670 × 190 mm · 64 × 16 pixels · 10 mm pitch · 12 perimeter fixings
Offset cut plane, stepped to take one screw per column · vertical scale ×3, horizontal 1:1

g.text: Front panel, 3 mm smoked grey plexiglass
Aluminium support panel, 2 mm, LED panels glued on
Long spacers, 22 mm, wiring and PCB
Back panel, 3 mm smoked grey plexiglass

svg.text: M5×40 countersunk socket screw from the front, M5 dome nut at the back · 36 mm stack leaves 4 mm of thread for the nut
